title: SMOK Nord Replacement Pod
description: This convenient replacement pod is designed for use with the Smok Nord Pod vape kit, providing up to 2ml of capacity for your e-liquid of choice. This pack contains two coil options to allow you to swap between different styles of vaping depending on your personal preference, with one 0.6ohm coil facilitating a flavoursome direct inhale with sub ohm e-liquids and another 1.4ohm coil option providing a deeply-delicious direct-to-lung experience with classic, 50:50 and nic salts. Includes 2 x Smok Nord Replacement Pods (1 x 0m6ohm & 1 x 1.4ohm)
